jobs.occupation: F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support our engineering activities, Airbus Aerostructures is looking for a

F&DT Structural Analysis Engineer (d/f/m)

In this role, you will contribute to the structural integrity and safety of Airbus aircraft. As a key member of our Structural Analysis Community, you will handle calculations and support our digital transformation initiatives, collaborating closely with design, production and subcontracting partners.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your Location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Create analysis models, static and/or F&DT calculations, reports and studies for Airbus aircraft structures (A350XWB and A320 Family)
- Prepare the definition of analysis methods and specifications
- Check internally and externally created analysis data and documentation
- Check relevant input to design for the creation of drawings for manufacturing and support other functions (i.e.: production, customer support) as needed
- Technically guide the sub-contracting companies providing structure analysis work
- Apply airworthiness regulations and relevant design principles
- Define and interpret structural tests for certification
- Monitor project performance
- Support the digital transformation within the structural analysis department by implementing automation, simplifying tools, and redesigning processes.

Desired Skills and Qualifications

- University degree in the engineering / aerospace field or similar qualification acquired in another way
- Experience in the development of aircraft structures (metal & composite) would be a plus
- Knowledge in numerical calculations
- Proficiency in analytical calculation methods (e.g.ISAMI, HSB, Niu, Bruhn)
- Solid knowledge in programming languages (e.g.: Python) and data analytics
- Motivation to work autonomously, take responsibilities and foster communication with all stakeholders
- Open and curious mindset proactively searching for continuous self-development
- English fluency in written and spoken form

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. jobs.description:
Senior Machine Learning Anti-Spoof Expert (all genders)

At Nect, we make digitalization tangible and secure. We develop AI- and biometrics-based trust services, including digital identity and signature solutions. Sounds technical? It is - but, more importantly, it’s exciting. Our technologies help public authorities and businesses prepare for the digital future. We are driven by our desire to demonstrate the simplicity and security of digital solutions while creating new opportunities for all. Are you ready to help shape the digital world of tomorrow with us?

About the role:

We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Machine Learning Expert to design, build, deploy, and optimize large-scale machine learning systems powering next-generation identity verification products. In this role, you will collaborate closely with ML scientists, backend engineers, DevOps teams, and product stakeholders to productionize advanced AI models used by millions of users every day. At Nect, you will have the opportunity to work on state-of-the-art machine learning technologies in biometrics, computer vision, and fraud prevention while helping shape scalable AI infrastructure for real-world applications.

You are responsible for:

Machine Learning Engineering

- Design, develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning systems for identity verification products at scale.
- Productionize advanced AI and deep learning models in collaboration with ML scientists and engineering teams.
- Improve model performance, reliability, scalability, and inference efficiency.
- Build and maintain robust ML pipelines for training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.
- Optimize real-time inference systems for high-throughput production environments.

Backend & Infrastructure

- Develop scalable Python-based backend services and microservices architectures.
- Deploy ML models through REST APIs and real-time inference services.
- Work with distributed systems and cloud-native infrastructure.
- Contribute to CI/CD workflows and operational excellence for ML services.

Collaboration & Technical Contribution

- Work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security teams.
- Participate in architecture discussions and technical decision-making.
- Help drive best practices in MLOps, scalability, and system reliability.

You bring with you:

- MSc or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of Machine Learning Engineering experience
- Experience with fraud prevention and detection (on media such as videos and images) and anti-spoofing.
- Experience working with biometric and media data (images, videos, audio), including face recognition, selfie verification, voice analysis, and ideally deepfake detection
- Combination of industry experience and a strong research background
- Strong Python skills
- Proven experience building, deploying, and operating ML systems in production environments
- Strong expertise in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, ML Pipelines, and MLOps
- Fluent English skills required

What we offer you:

- Flexible working and a modern working environment
- Scale-up culture with security and vision: digital, innovative, ambitious
- Flat hierarchies and quick decisions: real scope for your ideas
- Personal development: in a growing tech company with a future
- Modern office in Hamburg: central location between the Elbe and Alster rivers with a pleasant working atmosphere
- Health benefits: company health insurance package
- Team spirit: regular events and exchanges in a motivated environment
- Catering support: subsidy for your daily meals/snacks

Ready to help shape digital identity in Europe?

Then apply now - we look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description:
Who we are

Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.

The opportunity

At Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.

This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.

Day-to-day responsibilities

As a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.

Your key responsibilities include:

- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.
- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.
- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)
- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required
- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).
- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions
- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.
- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.

This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.

Who are we looking for

We look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.

- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).
- Professional proficiency of English and German is required
- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)
- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.
- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. 
- You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.
- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

At Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:

- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide
- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career
- An exciting salary
- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career
- And many more...

#LI-AB1

Shape the evolution

We are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. 

Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.com

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber: 
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: International Accounting/Financial Reporting Standards (IAS/IFRS), Rechnungslegung nach HGB
Expertenkenntnisse: Tabellenkalkulation Excel (MS Office)

jobs.occupation: EMEA Logistics Senior Purchaser (m/w/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.description:
The Regional Procurement Office (RPO) EMEA is responsible for procurement activities across Europe, Africa, the Middle East, and the Balkans. Within RPO EMEA, the Logistics Procurement Hub manages the sourcing of inland transportation services for wind turbine components, including port handling, factory-to-port transport, and delivery to installation sites. Our diverse and collaborative team supports wind energy projects across the region.

Responsibilities

The Logistics Senior Purchaser (m/f/d) is responsible for leading the sourcing and procurement of transport services for wind turbine components across the EMEA region, ensuring competitive, compliant, and strategically aligned solutions that support both tendering activities and project execution.

The role includes developing sourcing strategies, leading complex RFQs, conducting market analysis, negotiating commercial agreements, and managing supplier performance. The Specialist will work closely with stakeholders across logistics, construction, sales, finance, and legal functions to deliver value, mitigate risks, support business objectives, and contribute to winning projects and successful project execution.

This position is ideal for an experienced procurement professional with a strong commercial mindset, proven negotiation skills, and the ability to independently manage procurement activities in a dynamic international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

- Strategic Sourcing & RFQ Management: Develop and execute sourcing strategies, prepare and manage RFQs, and lead supplier selection processes to ensure competitive and reliable transportation solutions.
- Cost Management & Market Intelligence: Own the development and maintenance of transportation cost models and market benchmarks. Analyze supplier quotations, validate cost structures, and challenge pricing assumptions to ensure competitiveness and transparency. Identify market trends, risks, and opportunities, forecast cost developments, and provide data-driven recommendations that support sourcing strategies, tender activities, and business decisions.
- Bid & Project Support: Play a key role in supporting sales, tendering activities, and project execution by securing competitive transportation solutions, supplier capacity, and commercial insights. Develop accurate cost assessments and recommendations that contribute to winning projects while ensuring successful execution after award.
- Commercial Negotiation & Contract Management: Lead commercial negotiations and support the development of contractual agreements that align with business requirements while mitigating commercial and operational risks.
- Supplier Management & Development: Build and maintain strategic supplier relationships, monitor supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement initiatives related to cost, quality, capacity, and service delivery.
- Compliance & Stakeholder Collaboration: Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies and governance requirements while collaborating closely with logistics, construction, finance, legal, and sales stakeholders.

Qualifications

- 5+  years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Supply Chain, or a similar commercial function
- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, International Trade, Economics, Logistics, Industrial Engineering, or a related field
- German language skills at native speaker level are mandatory; Business-level English proficiency is essential, as all day-to-day communication, reporting, and documentation are conducted in English
- Experience within transport, logistics, heavy haulage, project cargo, infrastructure, energy, or other project-based industries is highly desirable, particularly in the planning and execution of oversized cargo transportation to site. Knowledge of route surveys, road modifications, permit management, and other requirements associated with wind turbine transportation is a strong advantage
- Advanced Excel skills and proficiency with analytical tools, with proven experience in price analysis, cost benchmarking, data interpretation, and identifying opportunities for cost optimization and process improvement
- Experience leading supplier negotiations and managing commercial agreements in a multinational environment
- Strong understanding of sourcing processes, supplier relationship management, contract negotiation, and procurement best practices
- Knowledge of SAP Ariba (Sourcing module) or similar procurement platforms is considered an advantage
- Willingness to travel occasionally across the EMEA region, as required (typically less than 15% of the time)

Competencies

- Strong analytical and commercial mindset with exceptional attention to detail. Comfortable working with data, conducting detailed price and cost comparisons, identifying trends and improvement opportunities, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
- Results-oriented, accountable, and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to delivering objectives
- Strong negotiation, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across functions, suppliers, and cultures
- Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions in a dynamic international environment
- Collaborative, adaptable, and easy to work with, fostering open communication and constructive partnerships with colleagues and suppliers

What We Offer 

We offer an exciting opportunity to join one of the world's leading renewable energy companies and play a key role in the procurement of transportation services supporting wind energy projects across the EMEA region. You will work in a highly international environment with significant exposure to strategic sourcing, supplier management, contract negotiations, and cross-functional collaboration. The role offers opportunities for professional growth, responsibility, and direct impact on business performance and project success. 

Your benefits – because your contribution counts!

- Start & Perspective: Structured onboarding program and a permanent employment contract with long-term prospects 
- Development & Skills: Varied work in a forward-looking industry and individual opportunities for professional growth
- Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Overtime account, option to work from home up to 8 days per month, 30 days of vacation plus Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve off, and the option for a sabbatical 
- Add-Ons: Business bike, gym allowance, company pension plan, Germany-wide train ticket (Deutschlandticket) 
- Team & Culture: Scandinavian-inspired with flat hierarchies, informal culture, and great team spirit

jobs.occupation: F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Airframe Engineering, Airbus Operations is looking for a

F&DT Lead Engineer for Fuselage Primary Structure (d/f/m)

Become part of a pioneering team with a strong identity and a shared commitment to delivering best-in-class stress solutions!

Join the Fuselage Structure Analysis team in Hamburg as a technical anchor in our newly integrated "One Fuselage" domain. As the Lead Engineer Fatigue & Damage Tolerance (F&DT) for Primary Structure, you will be a custodian of structural integrity, driving the F&DT justification for critical fuselage components across the entire aircraft lifecycle—from next-generation design and certification to manufacturing and global fleet support.

You will lead the delivery of mission-critical stress engineering data and shape the departmental strategy for innovation. This is a pivotal role where you will collaborate across a high-level network to integrate advanced simulations and structural health strategies. We are looking for a pioneering engineer driven by a "People First" spirit to help us create the future of aerospace structural excellence.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location - 2 options

Hamburg is home to the largest production site for civil aircraft. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.

Bremen is one of the country’s greenest cities. It offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days paid vacation and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, transportation subsidy, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Kindergarten close to the site, medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeteria
- Compatibility of family & work (job sharing, part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Lead Advanced Structural Analysis: Technically lead the project team for the fatigue and damage tolerance evaluations
- Define Airworthiness & Maintenance Criteria: Establish damage tolerance philosophies, including allowable damage limits, inspection thresholds, and repeat intervals to ensure long-term structural integrity
- Oversee Structural Testing: Plan and analyze fatigue tests across all levels, validating theoretical models with real-world data
- Drive Cross-Functional Certification: Collaborate with Design, Materials, and Stress teams to integrate F&DT requirements into the design phase, ensuring full compliance with regulatory airworthiness standards
- Support Fleet In-Service Solutions: Investigate structural failures and anomalies to determine root causes, while developing and validating effective repair schemes and service bulletins
- Manage Technical Project Deliverables: Define technical scopes, workload sizing, and lead times, ensuring high-quality inputs and the mitigation of technical risks/opportunities
- Strategic Reporting & Governance: Present progress and technical findings in steering ceremonies, providing clear clarification of assumptions and interdependencies to stakeholders
- Continuous Innovation & Method Improvement: Stay at the forefront of industry advancements to improve internal analysis tools, structural health monitoring strategies, and airworthiness limitation frameworks

In essence, you plan, structure, and deliver technical outputs for your area in Time, Cost and Quality. You guide colleagues and provide technical expertise, supported by senior team members.

Desired skills and qualifications

- You hold a Master's degree / Diploma in Engineering or similar qualifications
- You bring several years of experience in Fatigue & Damage Tolerance and associated Process, Methods & Tools
- You are experienced in technically leading employees
- You enjoy working with many interfaces with different knowledge levels and cultural backgrounds adapting your communication accordingly
- You have a creative data-driven mindset and are motivated to improve the way we work and interact with the world around us (e.g. using AI)
- You have the capabilities to interpret the environmental context and influence decision-making within the company
- Experience in Hyperworks and Python would be a plus
- Fluency in English is mandatory, German is appreciated

jobs.occupation: Scientific Programmer (mfd) High-Performance Computing and Software Engineering (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
The Max Planck Institute for Marine Microbiology is a research institute of the Max Planck Society. It was founded in 1992 in the State of Bremen and employs around 200 staff members. In close collaboration with numerous university and non-university research institutions, we explore the diversity and function of microorganisms in the ocean and their interactions with their environment. Scientists from all over the world, engineers, technicians and administrative staff together make an important contribution to global marine and environmental research.

In the Department of Ocean Biosphere Dynamics, we are looking to fill up a position as

Scientific Programmer (mfd)

High-Performance Computing and Software Engineering

The department investigates the dynamics of the ocean carbon cycle, its variability and predictability, and its role in the Earth system through climate–carbon cycle feedbacks operating across timescales from days to millennia. A central objective is to improve the representation of marine carbon, nutrient cycling and microbial processes in Earth System Models while increasing spatial model resolution to capture key physical and biogeochemical dynamics in the ocean.

To support this mission, we are seeking different Scientific Programmers (m/f/d) to drive the next generation of ocean biogeochemical modelling in Earth System Models. The successful candidates will contribute to the development, integration, and performance optimization of a state-of-the-art modelling framework, enabling increasingly sophisticated representations of marine biogeochemical processes and unprecedented high-resolution numerical experimentation. Together, they will help ensure that the modelling infrastructure combines scientific excellence with cutting-edge software engineering, delivering robust, efficient, and scalable performance on current and future exascale computing platforms.

The successful candidate will help ensure that the modelling framework of the HAMburg Ocean Carbon Cycle model (HAMOCC) which is part of the ICON Earth system modeling framework remains technologically advanced and capable of efficiently exploiting emerging HPC architectures. Emphasis will be placed on heterogeneous computing and the optimal use of CPU and GPU resources to maximize model performance, scalability, and portability.

A particular focus of the position will be a dedicated project to prepare, optimize, and benchmark the code for deployment on heterogeneous CPU/GPU systems, ensuring efficient performance and supporting the transition to next-generation HPC infrastructure.

The role involves close interactions with researchers, research students and model developers to translate scientific advances into reliable and maintainable model code. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to contribute to peer-reviewed publications and present research outcomes at scientific conferences.

Key responsibilities:

- Develop and optimize model code of HAMOCC for modern supercomputing architectures
- Enable and improve heterogeneous execution across CPUs and GPUs
- Lead and contribute to software development, maintaining Git repositories, testing and debugging, code review, and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) to ensure robust, maintainable, and reproducible code
- Implement performance analysis, profiling, and optimization strategies
- Support portability across current and future HPC platforms
- Collaborate with model developers to translate scientific requirements into efficient software solutions

Desired qualifications:

- Degree in computer science, computational science, applied mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with numerical modelling and analysis and handling of large simulation datasets
- Strong knowledge of HPC programming (Fortran and C/C++) and performance optimization
- Knowledge of parallel programming paradigms such as MPI, OpenMP, OpenACC or equivalent technologies
- Experience with large-scale scientific software projects, including software testing and debugging, code review workflows
- Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices, including Git
- Fluent in English, with solid scientific writing skills and a strong interest in working collaboratively within an international and interdisciplinary team

What we offer:

This position is initially offered for three years. Continuation beyond the initial term is intended, subject to satisfactory performance, applicable legal requirements, and the availability of funding.

We offer a position in an international science environment. You can expect a multifaceted job with challenging tasks in an exciting, academic work environment. You will have a high degree of autonomy and creative freedom, and we will promote your further education, e.g. within the framework of external courses and certifications. The compatibility of private life, family and career are important components of our personnel policy. You will be paid according to the collective agreement for the public service (TVöD Bund). Allowances are possible depending on qualifications and areas of responsibility.

Are you interested?

We look forward to receiving your full application via our online application portal. This should include a statement of interest, CV, publication list (when applicable) and a list of references (with contact information). Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Applications received by 15 September 2026 will receive full consideration; applications received after that date may be considered until the position is filled.

The Max Planck Society is committed to employing more disabled individuals and especially encourages them to apply. The Max Planck Society strives for gender and diversity equality. We welcome applications from all backgrounds.

We are looking forward to your application!

The Leibniz Institute for the Analysis of Biodiversity Change (LIB) is one of the large, globally connected research museums of the Leibniz Association. Curator Ornithology (m/f/d)

in full-time 39.00 hours/week, at LIB Hamburg, representing research at an internationally competitive level. The successful candidate will bring together the bird collection and ornithological research on biodiversity change in space and time.

- Evolution of phenotypic traits

A Snapshot of Your Day 

Enjoy being part of a great team of experienced Legal Counsels and Contract Managers shaping the energy landscape of the future! In your role as a member of this team you will actively support the manifold activities coming along with the project business of Siemens Energy’s GS Solutions. The world is currently facing a transition of the energy market that is characterized by an increasing energy demand, and you will take responsibility for a broad variety of complex contractual matters in this exciting environment. Your primary task is the contractual support in the field of commercial contracts during the execution of national and international large-scale projects (EPC) by means of analyzing contracts, identifying contractual risks, drafting and negotiating agreements, and advising and supporting project and site management to tackle the challenges arising in large project business. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Provide advice and support to project and site management during execution of customer contracts, consortium agreements, and sub-contracts to protect Siemens Energy’s rights and entitlements
* Support contractual and commercial matters, including claim and change order processes as well as reviewing and drafting relevant correspondence
* Identify technical, commercial, and contractual aspects to establish project-specific claim strategies and support pursuing and defending incoming and outgoing claims
* Contribute to claim management through collection and evaluation of project records, documentation, and relevant facts, including support in settlement negotiations
* Collaborate with legal teams by substantiating cause-and-effect relationships to demonstrate entitlement to claims, extensions of time, or defenses in arbitration/ADR
* Supervise or perform quantum and delay analyses to establish causation for events impacting project schedule and scope of work

What You Bring
* Long-term experience in contract and claim management, contract analysis, drafting and/or legal experience, or relevant legal/commercial academic background with experience in large-scale projects
* Strong knowledge of international EPC and construction contracts (e.g. FIDIC, Orgalime, NEC, MF1)
* Ability to work collaboratively with project, site, and legal teams
* Fluent English and German negotiation skills; additional languages are a plus
* Experience working in international teams and with international contractual partners
* Academic degree in a technical field, business administration, law, or quantity surveying, combined with knowledge in valuation and scheduling/project controls and willingness to travel 

About the Team

Do you want to be part of an experienced, unique and great team?

At the earliest date possible, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team in Legal and Compliance Team in Gas Services, with a primary focus to support our business partners’ activities during the execution of complex project business.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

jobs.occupation: AOG Customer Service Specialist (d/f/m) (Serviceingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Job description

Übersetzbarer Rich-Text You will become a member of Satair, the largest Airbus Services company providing Airbus spares and services to all Airbus customers on this earth and maybe in future even further. Satair AOG Management is located in Hamburg and Washington and counts approx. 50 team members. AOG Management Hamburg serves customers in Europe, Middle East, Africa and Asia Pacific. Check out what the Satair AOG Management Team and our stakeholders do @ https://youtu.be/dyqI6DNC2U8 and www.satair.com

What can you expect?Find alternative solutions to all kind of AOG situations to recover customers aircraft around the world Cater for a round the clock AOG spares support

Work with a very dynamic team in a very international environment

Manage a different case every day, routine is not part of the job!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees. Local benefits may vary. Competitive Remuneration

Work / Life Balance: Hybrid Working, flex-time, maternity/paternity leave, job sharing

Personal Development: Personalized development plans, large portfolio of learning solutions & lots of internal mobility opportunities

Health & Wellbeing: Health insurance, well-being programs

HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM Serve and satisfy customers "Aircraft On Ground" material requirements 24/7/365 by finding favorable solutions.

Coordination and interface between the customer and the Airbus spare parts order process. Administer the complete customer order including initial receipt, sourcing, escalation and delivery follow-up.

Ensure on-time delivery for all spare parts and related services to all Airbus customers in the EMEA and APAC region using technical and commercial data.

Requires a high degree of independence, ability to develop creative solutions, self initiative and flexibility while continuously providing a high caliber of customer service under, sometimes, demanding situations.

Extensive customer interaction requires the ability to communicate effectively in English - both verbally and written. Communication skills focus on the customer satisfaction are required.

Providing a positive and helpful customer service experience with a high exposure to cultural awareness.

This position requires shift work, on a 24/7 pattern, including, weekends, nights and bank holidays. (35 hours/week + 2.5 hours due to the shift model, total is 37.5 hours/week).

ABOUT YOUProfessional requirementsHolding a degree in Supply Chain, Engineering or a related discipline is an advantage You have solid professional experience within an AOG desk environment or similar

You have experience in stakeholder management

Negotiation level in English is mandatory

Fluent in Chinese or another language is a plus

Solid knowledge in SAP SD, MM and WM is a must

Solid knowledge in technical data such as IPC, CMM, technical drawings… is a must

As a personyou have the ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

you have the ability to multitask

you like to work in a diverse and international team

you have a solution-oriented and pro-active mind set

You have practical problem solving skills

you are an excellent communicator with good coordination and Cultural awareness skills

having the service and support towards the customer is part of your DNA

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Satair is striving for a culture of diversity and inclusiveness with continuous learning, speak up, listen up, and act with integrity and respect. So we welcome any application independent from the social and cultural background, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion of the applicant.

What does your next challenge look like?At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

About SATAIR

Satair offers first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. We are working to be the most customer-centric organization in providing commercial aviation spares parts to make the world continue flying. We are constantly taking customer experience to new levels by improving how we fulfill and deliver customers’ orders quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. To meet this goal, Satair is continually striving to innovate and provide best-in-class service levels by pioneering new products and services in a fast growing business environment.

With our global functional organization spanning across 11 different sites and locations worldwide with more than 1.800 people and a turnover of over $3.0 billion, you will be part of a truly global family.

Our customers have the ultimate goal to operate their fleet and our Airbus aircraft safely, efficiently in a cost-time-quality effective manner and of course with the expected comfort level for their customers. We at Satair do everything to support our customers in this. If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

Satair (a 100% subsidiary of Airbus) is offering first class material management solutions in the aftermarket business of the aviation industry. With our global functional organisation spanning across eleven different sites and locations worldwide, you will be part of a truly global family. Change is the only constant at Satair. The aviation industry is an ever changing - and fast moving environment. That calls for someone special - someone like you! Welcome to the Satair family!

jobs.occupation: Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Windtunnel Test team, Airbus Operations is looking for a

Working student within Software Engineering (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Windtunnel Testengineer (d/f/m)? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Windtunnel Test team as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Bremen
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: 12 months

You will receive a collectively agreed salary of at least €19.10 per hour, depending on the job. There are also special payments such as vacation pay.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Bremen is a charming city full of history in the northwest of Germany. In addition to being one of the country’s greenest cities, it offers wonderful sights, a rich culture, urban flair and culinary delights. It’s also a great place for seaside lovers, being located just an hour’s drive from the North Sea coast.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Feature Development: You will support our team in developing and implementing new features for our Wind Tunnel Environment
- Quality Assurance: You will help us maintain high standards by writing unit tests and assisting in bug fixing.
- Collaboration: You will participate in regular meetings and task planning
- Independent Work: After your onboarding, you should work independently on your own tasks and sub-projects.
- Technical Support: You will assist in documenting and optimizing existing codebases.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled fulltime student (d/f/m) in a Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related degree program (minimum 3rd semester achieved).
- You have a solid grasp of at least one programming language (e.g., Python, C++, Java)
- You understand the basics of version control (Git) and are eager to learn professional workflows.
- Problem Solver Mindset: You are curious, proactive, and not afraid to ask "why?".
- You are fluent in English or German and enjoy working in a collaborative environment.
- Mastering Message Brokers: There is a chance that you will dive deep into event-driven architectures. A key part of your role could be learning and implementing messaging systems like Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ to connect our microservices.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.occupation: Project Coordinator (m/w/d) (Luftverkehrsmanager/in)
jobs.description:
Who We Are
As a provider of industrial services, we at DAHER Industrial Services carry out mechanical, structural, electrical, and cabin work on aircraft or aircraft components at our customers’ sites.
Every day, around 200 employees from approximately 30 different nations ensure that we achieve our goals and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
DAHER Industrial Services is a subsidiary of the DAHER Group, headquartered in France. The DAHER Group operates worldwide as an important player in the aerospace and defense industries.

OUR BENEFITS  

- Financial Perks: Free public transport with the Deutschlandticket, €50 monthly budget on your DAHER Corporate Account or for EGYM Wellpass, plus an employee referral program 
- Work-Life Balance: Flexible working hours and remote work options 
- Compensation: Overtime pay and bonuses for weekend and holiday shifts 
- Culture & Events: Regular team and company events, including summer parties 
- Health & Retirement: Occupational health management and a company pension scheme 
- Learning & Development: Extensive training and development opportunities

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES  

- Support tenders and feasibility studies, including cost and time estimates 
- Coordinate and manage projects to meet quality, schedule, and financial targets 
- Act as the key interface for customers and internal teams  
- Drive project monitoring, KPIs, and continuous improvement. 
- Support recruiting, onboarding, and the development of project team members.  
- Ensure team qualifications, training, and availability of required resources 
- Ensure full compliance with Quality, Safety & Environment (QSE) standards 

YOUR PROFILE  

- You hold a university degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautics or a comparable field 
- You bring at least 3–4 years of experience in technical and commercial project management 
- You have experience in the aeronautical sector, ideally with “Outstanding Works” knowledge; this is considered a strong advantage 
- You demonstrate a strong understanding of aeronautical standards and processes environments 
- You communicate confidently, show leadership qualities, and maintain a strong customer focus  
- You are fluent in English and French, German is considered a plus 
- You are proficient in MS Office and Google Suite 
- You work in a structured, solution-oriented, reliable, and analytical manner oriented, reliable

Sounds exciting? It is.
We look forward to receiving detailed applications, including the earliest possible starting date, via our application portal.
DAHER Industrial Services values diversity and equal treatment – regardless of gender, skin colour, religion, culture, or nationality.
